row.body: Personal note — the late afternoon: wash off the a sharp solvent smell left by the orchard spray test crew. the mare refused her feed, and I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.
row.title: the late afternoon — a sharp solvent smell

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sharp solvent smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
